# Argo CD Declarative GitOps & Automated Sync Drift

Declarative GitOps deployment with Argo CD: single source of truth in Git, automated sync, drift detection, and sync windows.

## Invariants
- GIT_REPOSITORY_IS_EXCLUSIVE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH
- AUTO_HEAL_OUT_OF_SYNC_CLUSTER_DRIFT
- IMMUTABLE_APPLICATION_CONFIGS
